repository.description: Kubernetes session management and orchestration platform

overview.summary: High-performance Kubernetes session orchestrator with enterprise-grade fault tolerance and distributed consensus. Manages 5000+ active sessions with 99.99% uptime SLA.

p0_risks.title: Kubernetes RBAC misconfiguration
p0_risks.description: Service account has overly permissive cluster-admin role

p1_risks.title: Unencrypted secrets in etcd
p1_risks.description: Session tokens stored without encryption at rest

recommendations.title: Optimize session state synchronization
recommendations.description: Current gossip protocol adds 15-20ms latency. Consider Raft consensus.

recommendations.title: Implement TLS 1.3 for inter-node communication
recommendations.description: Current TLS 1.2 endpoints vulnerable to known attacks.
